offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems for people with diabetes. Systems combine a wearable sensor, transmitter and app or receiver, sold to patients via pharmacies and distributors and supported by clinicians and payers.

primary_products.value: continuous glucose monitoring sensors; transmitters; receivers; mobile apps and data software

customer_segment.value: B2C: people with type 1 and type 2 diabetes using CGM; B2B: pharmacies, distributors, healthcare providers and insurers/payers; B2G: government health programs such as Medicare and Medicaid, and public health systems

revenue_model.value: product sales: CGM sensors, transmitters and receivers sold through distributors, pharmacies and directly; healthcare reimbursement: payments from insurers and government programs covering CGM supplies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures CGM sensors and devices from purchased components, sold to distributors, pharmacies and patients; software / platform: companion apps and cloud data platforms for patients and clinicians

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Canada, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: continuous glucose monitoring devices and related software

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: large medical supply distributors serving patients and payers; third-party retail: retail pharmacy chains dispensing CGM supplies; direct sales: sales to clinicians and prescribers, direct-to-patient and international sales; online: online ordering and over-the-counter sales
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and international approvals, reimbursement rules and health data privacy laws
